blueprint: Compose existing subject-ontology, evidence, projection, UI-state, and workflow-owner capabilities. Do not create a universal LearningGraph ontology or executable route graph.
minimal_composition: source ontology + evidence/finding graph -> exact-bound learner projection -> session-supplied confusion/question state -> typed unknown/residue split -> workflow-derived non-executing route suggestion

layers.owner: subject ontology and Rule realization profile owners

layers.proof_status: executed for fixtures; unverified for real source
unverified for new fields; observed for focus and selection

layers.owner: existing workflow, Task Session, dispatch, and authority owners
workflow-derived suggestion renderer plus destination owner

candidate_nodes.semantics: candidate realization type aligned to DS-D1.7
candidate_nodes.evidence: inherited binding and callable properties plus profile expectations
candidate_nodes.invalidation: source digest changes, owner rejects alignment, or inherited contract changes
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: A boolean-looking callable is not thereby a DomainSpec Rule

candidate_nodes.evidence: path, arrow form, export, and binding constraints
candidate_nodes.invalidation: profile digest or owner disposition changes
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: A profile expectation is not a source observation

candidate_nodes.semantics: hand-authored fixture observation with empty and non-current binding
candidate_nodes.invalidation: fixture changes or a real adapter supersedes it
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: Not real-source evidence and not semantic identity
candidate_nodes.proof_status: executed as evaluator input; unverified as real source

candidate_nodes.semantics: learner-authored question text scoped to one session
candidate_nodes.invalidation: session ends, learner revises the question, or bindings change
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: Never promote question text to canonical ontology

candidate_nodes.semantics: learner-visible absence of owner-resolved binding and real-adapter evidence
candidate_nodes.owner: learner projection owner with language-adapter owner route
candidate_nodes.evidence: fixture-only source, empty binding, no adapter receipt
candidate_nodes.invalidation: owner-resolved binding plus frozen real-adapter evidence appears
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: Do not collapse learner uncertainty, source residue, and workflow blocker

candidate_nodes.semantics: non-executing candidate handoff to obtain real-adapter evidence
candidate_nodes.evidence: typed unknown plus destination owner and proposed witness
candidate_nodes.invalidation: unknown resolves, owner changes, or prerequisites fail
candidate_nodes.misuse_warning: Cannot confirm, select, register, dispatch, execute, or promote

candidate_relations.semantics: session question selects an immutable semantic anchor for inspection
candidate_relations.evidence: IOLM learnerView precedent plus exact ontology pointer
candidate_relations.misuse_warning: Not a semantic assertion about the question
Expectation is neither observation nor identity proof

candidate_relations.semantics: typed supplied facts are compared with selected constraints
candidate_relations.misuse_warning: Mismatch is not a runtime, semantic, or authority verdict

candidate_relations.semantics: inspection exposes a bounded epistemic gap
candidate_relations.evidence: absence of adapter and owner-decision receipt

candidate_relations.semantics: typed unresolved evidence gap yields a candidate owner handoff
candidate_relations.evidence: missing adapter witness plus owner route
candidate_relations.invalidation: unknown resolves or destination owner rejects scope
candidate_relations.misuse_warning: Never interpret as confirmation or execution

candidate_relations.semantics: session-local progression from broad confusion to falsifiable evidence question
candidate_relations.invalidation: learner rejects progression or context changes
candidate_relations.misuse_warning: Do not infer comprehension or semantic entailment

positive_witness.subject: payment.MaxAmountRule
steps: apply base-domain constraint /constraints/5 and TypeScript constraints /constraints/0,3,5
observe zero expected findings for that element
conclude only that the supplied fixture conforms to the candidate profile
positive_witness.claim_ceiling: No owner-decision receipt proves DS-D1.7 identity and no real adapter inspected real source.

abstention_witness.question: Is LegacyLimitRule really a DomainSpec Rule in a live repository?
abstention_witness.response: ABSTAIN. Binding is empty and non-current, the digest is example-only-not-a-product-receipt, and no real adapter or owner-resolved binding exists.
abstention_witness.allowed_output: display the typed unknown and owner route
forbidden_output: route beyond obtaining owner-resolved binding and real-adapter evidence

next_route_contract.example_witness: frozen source fixture -> AST/module resolution -> typed observation projection -> existing evaluator

html_integration_hypothesis.approach: Extend the existing architecture canvas as a read-only learner projection, not a second learning-map product.
acceptance: no learner relation in semantic export
html_integration_hypothesis.claim_ceiling: Rendering evidence would not prove comprehension, accessibility acceptance, semantic admission, deployment, or production readiness.

MERGE: learner projection into IOLM learnerView and existing canvas
typed carrier into OCGP and CAV2 node/relation discipline
focus scenes into OEW/Body War presentation patterns
DEFER: positive comprehension until qualified human receipt
real TypeScript realization until native adapter and owner binding
IOLM full integration until A2-A4/browser closure
OEW final acceptance until typed repair

preserved_tensions: MaxAmountRule is the positive fixture-conformance witness; LegacyLimitRule is the diagnostic and abstention witness.
Executed focus and selection mechanics do not make the incomplete IOLM and semantic-navigation journeys complete.
Unknown remains a typed split among learner uncertainty, source residue, and workflow blocker.
residue: non-primary source claims remain transcript-bound at observed status when a digest was not carried
no canonical admission for learner-question, unknown, or next-route vocabulary
claim_ceiling: Candidate non-authoritative composition blueprint only; no real-source behavior, semantic admission, comprehension, accessibility acceptance, route execution, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production readiness.
